ai_seo.title: AI Search Engine Readiness (GEO)
ai_seo.subtitle: Audit your website for ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Applebot crawlers. Test llms.txt standard and robots.txt permissions.
ai_seo.readiness_desc: Calculated based on robots.txt crawler permissions, llms.txt availability, semantic schema structure, and SSRF-safe AI readability.
ai_seo.llms_desc: llms.txt provides structured, lightweight context to LLMs about your key documentation, APIs, and product offerings.
ai_seo.create_llms_prompt: Generate optimized llms.txt template for this domain
ai_seo.why_important: Why Does Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Matter?
ai_seo.why_important_desc: Modern search experiences (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) rely on direct AI bots. Blocking them cuts your brand from generative answers.
ai_seo.schema_missing_warn: No schema.org structured data detected. Add JSON-LD to help AI engines understand your entity relationships.
ai_seo.recommended_robots_desc: Copy and paste this block into your robots.txt to ensure maximum visibility across all major AI search engines.
ai_seo.fix_files_title: Fix Files for This Website (Without Deleting Original Code)
ai_seo.fix_files_desc: Seovy retrieves your live website files, appends required AI crawler permissions and llms.txt references, and gives them back safely without deleting your existing rules.
ai_seo.preview_modified_robots: Preview robots.txt with AI Rules Added
ai_seo.original_content_preserved: Original website rules preserved; AI bot permissions appended at the end.
ai_seo.install_instructions: Upload these files to your website's root directory (e.g. public_html/ or your domain root).
ai_seo.bots_permission_desc: Crawler permissions analyzed from your robots.txt file.
ai_seo.status_preserve_notice: Original rules preserved; AI directives appended.
ai_seo.knowledge_desc: Structured data helps LLMs accurately understand your entities.
ai_seo.merger_desc: Download files with AI rules added without losing existing setup.
ai_seo.guide_step1_desc: Get the merged robots.txt and llms.txt generated for your site.
ai_seo.guide_step2_desc: Upload to public_html or your web root via FTP or cPanel.
ai_seo.guide_step3_desc: Click re-check above to confirm all AI search engines have access.

features.conversion_subtitle: Identify all technical issues in seconds, boost your SEO health score, and collaborate with your team.
features.hero_subtitle: An all-in-one SEO platform running on your own server, featuring multi-workspace support, SSRF-protected async crawler, and 25+ technical audit rules.
features.crawler_desc: High-speed asynchronous crawler infrastructure with built-in AWS metadata, localhost, and private IP blocking.
features.audit_desc: Automated auditing of broken links, HTTP status codes, heading hierarchy, canonical tags, OpenGraph, and meta robots.
features.rank_desc: Smart engine and API-backed keyword rankings, daily shift analytics, and historical position trend charts.
features.workspaces_desc: Isolated workspaces for clients and internal projects. Role-based permission matrix for owners, editors, and viewers.
features.reports_desc: Generate and share professional SEO audit reports with your company logo and custom branding in one click.
features.ai_desc: Smart AI suggestions for content optimization, meta tag generation, and priority technical issue resolution.
features.billing_desc: Fully integrated billing and quota management supporting Stripe, PayTR, Iyzico, Paddle, and 10+ local and global providers.
features.branding_desc: Full dark and light mode support, custom logo upload, dynamic favicon, and complete white-label presentation.
features.security_desc: Self-hosted software architecture keeping your data secure on your own servers without sharing with third parties.
